description: The market as a whole right now, from what CryptoCoinStat reads: risk appetite 0–100 (funding, which side the last day of liquidations hit, how many top alts are up over a week, Google search interest; each part shown), altcoin season 0–100 (how many of the top 100 alts beat bitcoin over 90 days), leverage 0–100 (open-interest-weighted funding and how many perp markets run hot), real volume (the share of venue-reported volume their order books could carry), 24h liquidations split into longs and shorts, unlocks due in 30 days in dollars and days of depth, and search interest against its 90-day mean. With the change over a day or a week. Use when someone asks about market sentiment, fear and greed, altcoin season, leverage or liquidations across the market.
